title: Bounded site comparison of tensor evaluation transposes
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum [def-pur-conventions]: $k$ is an algebraic closure of a finite field of characteristic $p$, $\ell\ne p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $n\ge1$ and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. All schemes are finite-type $k$-schemes and every morphism to which compact support is applied is separated and finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. No absolute separatedness is assumed. For each such $h:S\to T$ choose $c_h=(j_h:S\hookrightarrow\overline S,r_h:\overline S\to T)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], put $C_V=\nu_V^*$ [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], $F_h^e=Rr_{h,e,*}j_{h,!}^e$ and $F_h^p=Rr_{h,p,*}j_{h,!}^p$. Use the specified proper-mate/open comparison $B_h:C_TF_h^e\xrightarrow{\sim}F_h^pC_S$ [lem-pur-compact-support-site-coherence], the ordinary etale right adjoint $G_h^e$ [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], the transported $G_h^p=Rh^!$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and their counits $\varepsilon_h^e,\varepsilon_h^p$. Write $a_{h,L}=\rho_L:C_SG_h^eL\xrightarrow{\sim}G_h^pC_TL$ for the comparison induced by the site-adjunction unit, with the bounded-origin Hom normalization of [lem-pur-bounded-site-adjunction-transpose]. Only bounded-below etale inputs, bounded-below exceptional images, and bounded-below intermediate etale objects of the displayed composites are used; all pro-etale exceptional Hom bijections are the bounded etale-origin ones.

Let $f:X\to Y$ be one of these morphisms, $M\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Let $e:F_f^eM\to A_Y$ be any morphism, and set $e_p=C_Y(e)\circ B_{f,M}^{-1}:F_f^pC_XM\to C_YA_Y\cong A_Y$. Use ordinary derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor], and the canonical coefficient-unit, tensor and pullback comparisons [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons, lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. Let $P^e$ be the proper counit-mate/open compactification projection [def-kun-projection-formula-map, lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor], and $P^p$ the specified compactification projection [def-exchange-projection]. Both are invertible at $(M,K)$ and $(C_XM,C_YK)$.
Define $u_e:M\otimes^Lf_e^*K\to G_f^eK$ to be the adjoint transpose of
$$z_e:F_f^e(M\otimes^Lf_e^*K)\xrightarrow{(P^e)^{-1}}F_f^eM\otimes^LK\xrightarrow{e\otimes1}A_Y\otimes^LK\xrightarrow{\sim}K,$$
and $u_p:C_XM\otimes^Lf_p^*C_YK\to G_f^pC_YK$ as the specified bounded-origin transpose of the identical composite with $P^p,e_p$ and the pro-etale left unitor. With the canonical source identification $h:C_X(M\otimes^Lf_e^*K)\xrightarrow{\sim}C_XM\otimes^Lf_p^*C_YK$, one has
$$u_p\circ h=a_{f,K}\circ C_X(u_e).$$
The equality also holds with the two source tensor factors reversed, using canonical symmetry. In particular, whenever $M=G_f^eA_Y$ is bounded constructible, $e=\varepsilon^e_{f,A_Y}$ and the above domain conditions hold, it identifies the specified $\theta^e_{f,K}$ with $\theta^p_{f,C_YK}$ [def-pur-co-smoothness], using $a_{f,A_Y}$ on the dualizing factor. All equalities are natural in $M,K,e$; no projection outside this finite-Tor domain is inverted.

proof.text: The proved compact_projection_square in the recorded projection-comparison module applies directly to the supplied finite coefficient A, bounded-below M and tensor J. Cancel comparison of the etale projection component. Use the two defining evaluation equations and siteTensorUnitEvaluation to identify the untransposed arrows. No coefficient-ring transport or extra dimension bound is needed.

Apply the proved boundedSiteTranspose_compatible computation of the defining bounded Hom chain to this untransposed square. This gives the forward-factor equation. Expand the specified reverse comparison: its two pro-etale braidings cancel by symmetry. Source naturality of boundedSiteTranspose then gives the reverse-factor equation, with the existing derived braiding and its signs.

For the dualizing clause write d=H(eta_unit;U(coefficientUnit)). Its image under comparison is exactly boundedTensorDualizingRho. Naturality of the compact-support comparison and of the etale counit, followed by naturality and the left triangle identity of the site adjunction, gives F_p(C(d));epsilon_p = comparedEvaluation.

Naturality of the projection moves C(d) from the source tensor to the evaluation. The preceding counit equation makes the resulting evaluation precisely the compared one. Apply the same tensor-evaluation square and bounded Hom-chain computation as above. Naturality of the canonical tensor/pullback source identification and source naturality of the Hom chain move the supplied jp witness through the transpose; jp inverse followed by jp cancels. This proves the displayed dualizing equation.
The existing naturality proof is unchanged: source and target naturality of both adjunctions and the canonical compact-support comparison prove its two clauses.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q134-bc4add5b5 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item and every cited statement in full: lem-pur-projection-comparison-etale-origin, def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction, lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison, lem-pur-compact-support-site-coherence, lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons, def-pur-bounded-site-transpose-arrows, lem-pur-bounded-site-adjunction-transpose, thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison, def-exchange-projection, def-pur-co-smoothness, and the parent's Step 3. Also read the blueprint lem-pur-co-smooth-etale-locality proof Steps 1-4. The statement is byte-identical to the base and the item is still unsplit on live; there are no new nodes. Step 1: substituting C=B^{-1} into the projection square gives r∘C(P^e)=P^p∘b, and inverting the two assumed isomorphisms gives the displayed equation. The identification C=B^{-1} follows from the statements of the construction def, the coherence lemma and the transpose def (open part named in the cited node). Step 2: tensor naturality plus left-unitor preservation give v_p b=C(v_e), hence z_p F_p(h) B_J=C(z_e). Step 3: the Hom-chain is the same as Phi of the stmt_dep lemma; naturality of the unit eta and of the etale adjunction gives rho_K∘C_X(u_e), with rho_K=C_X G^e(eta_K). All objects involved are bounded below: J is bounded by finite Tor amplitude, and G^eK is in D^+ by finite cohomological amplitude. Step 4: preservation of the Koszul symmetry plus source naturality gives the reversed-factor equality. Step 5: with e=eps^e the etale transpose is 1, so e_p=eps^p∘F_p(rho_A). Naturality of P^p in its first variable (invertible at omega by conjugation) then gives exactly theta^p of def-pur-co-smoothness. Edge cases tested: zero M, K and e; identity f; K=A; odd shifts. No duplicate found (the exchange-transposes, compositor-conjugates and unital-cancellation nodes cover other clauses). Accepted tool_use: lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons (off-route, generic symmetric-monoidal pullback); the other two declared tools lie on the route. No SGA source. Advisory: the dim X̄<=D hypothesis the worker avoided is always satisfiable, so citing the transpose lemma would also have been fine.
